audience: HR and finance teams that run employer-of-record staff, contractors and payroll in Oyster

useCases.title: Look up the team and its departments
useCases.text: List the team members with their role, type and start date, and list the departments. Open one person for the employment details and benefits. Personal details stay out of the list.

useCases.title: Review the time off requests and balances
useCases.text: List the time off requests that wait for a decision. Check the remaining days of each person in the time off balances.

useCases.title: Approve or reject a time off request
useCases.text: Open a pending time off request to read its dates and reason. Then approve it, or reject it with a reason the team member sees.

useCases.title: Review and decide on expenses
useCases.text: List the expenses that wait for review and open one to check its amount and receipt. Then approve it for reimbursement, or decline it with a reason the team member sees.

useCases.title: Check the company's Oyster invoices
useCases.text: Filter the company's Oyster invoices by status or charge status. Open one to see its line items, tax and document links.

useCases.title: Find time sheets that wait for approval
useCases.text: List the time sheets with their status to find those that wait for submission or approval. Open one to see the daily entries and time off days.
